# Silverline Trading Company

> Premium Himalayan salt exporter from Pakistan. Exporting pink salt, white salt, black salt, and custom crafted salt products worldwide.

## About

Silverline Trading Company (STC) is a Pakistan-based exporter specializing in premium Himalayan salt products. We source our salt from the Khewra Salt Mines, the world's second-largest salt mine, located in the Punjab region of Pakistan. We supply bulk and custom salt products to businesses worldwide.

## Products

### Himalayan Pink Salt
- Available in: 2-5mm granules, 1-2mm granules, fine, powder
- Uses: Culinary seasoning, gourmet cooking, food processing, spa & wellness
- Origin: Khewra Salt Mines, Pakistan
- Properties: Contains 84 trace minerals, naturally pink-colored, unrefined

### Himalayan White Salt
- Available in: 2-5mm granules, 1-2mm granules, fine, powder
- Uses: Table salt, food manufacturing, industrial applications
- Origin: Khewra Salt Mines, Pakistan
- Properties: Purest form of Himalayan salt, minimal mineral coloring

### Himalayan Black Salt (Kala Namak)
- Available in: 2-5mm granules, 1-2mm granules, fine, powder
- Uses: South Asian cuisine, vegan egg substitute, Ayurvedic medicine
- Origin: Khewra Salt Mines, Pakistan
- Properties: Distinctive sulfurous flavor, rich in iron and other minerals

### Custom Salt Products
- Custom granule sizes and blends
- Private label and white label options
- Custom packaging solutions
- Bulk orders for export
